mapper.select: SELECT r.record_id, r.emp_id, r.att_date, r.att_start_time, r.att_end_time, r.att_status, r.is_supplement, r.att_type, r.att_sub_type, r.apply_id, r.day, r.create_time, r.update_time, COALESCE(e.emp_code, '') AS emp_code, COALESCE(e.emp_name, '') AS emp_name FROM hr_att_record r LEFT JOIN sys_emp e ON r.emp_id = e.emp_id WHERE r.record_id = #{recordId}

SELECT r.record_id, r.emp_id, r.att_date, r.att_start_time, r.att_end_time, r.att_status, r.is_supplement, r.att_type, r.att_sub_type, r.apply_id, r.day, r.create_time, r.update_time, COALESCE(e.emp_code, '') AS emp_code, COALESCE(e.emp_name, '') AS emp_name FROM hr_att_record r LEFT JOIN sys_emp e ON r.emp_id = e.emp_id WHERE r.emp_id = #{empId} AND r.att_date = #{attDate} ORDER BY r.att_start_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.emp_id AS empId, SUM( CASE WHEN ((r.att_type != 'LEAVE' AND r.att_type != 'OVERTIME') OR (r.att_type = 'LEAVE' AND r.att_sub_type = 'ANNUAL')) THEN COALESCE(r.day, 0) ELSE 0 END ) AS normalDays, SUM( CASE WHEN (r.att_type = 'LEAVE' AND (r.att_sub_type IS NULL OR r.att_sub_type != 'ANNUAL')) THEN COALESCE(r.day, 0) ELSE 0 END ) AS leaveDays, SUM( CASE WHEN (r.att_type = 'OVERTIME') THEN COALESCE(r.day, 0) ELSE 0 END ) AS overtimeDays FROM hr_att_record r WHERE r.att_date >= #{startDate} AND r.att_date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY r.emp_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hr_att_record (emp_id, att_date, att_start_time, att_end_time, att_status, is_supplement, att_type, att_sub_type, apply_id, day) VALUES (#{empId}, #{attDate}, #{attStartTime}, #{attEndTime}, #{attStatus}, #{isSupplement}, #{attType}, #{attSubType}, #{applyId}, #{day})
